title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image from the context menu
summary: Hold: the updated Edge policy documentation explicitly includes sharing an image with Copilot from the context menu. The briefing incorrectly says that this interaction, its page-content protection and its regional access defaults are undocumented; the documented control paths and roadmap details remain correct.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Learn leaves it unconfirmed whether its DLP-protected-page content exclusion covers the image-sharing action.
claims.quote:
sharing an image with Copilot from the context menu ("Ask Copilot about this image")

claims.fix: Replace the image-coverage caveat with: 'The policy's documented contextual queries include image sharing, and Copilot cannot access page content on DLP-protected pages even when the policy is enabled.' Remove the open question and rationale premise that Microsoft has not confirmed this policy's DLP coverage for the image action. Pilot testing can remain advice to validate enforcement.
